scoring_justification: Recompute from raw charge density/eigenvalue logs is infeasible because the task only requires the agent to report the extracted numbers, not the raw data; thus result-level comparison against paper-reported reference values with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for optimized x, bandwidth threshold, half-metallicity/metalicity flags, and peak charge densities.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'Geometry optimization and electronic structure of BaCoO₃' Solid State Communications 128 (2003) 101–106. Optimized x=0.1284, band structure description: d_{x²−y²} band dispersionless (bandwidth negligible), half-metallic for x=0.1284, metallic for x=0.1450, peak densities 2.2 e/Å³ and 1.3 e/Å³.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's text and reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the actual quantities the paper claims; they serve as the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Optimized oxygen position parameter x from geometry relaxation.
Electronic structure metrics: bandwidth of d_{x²−y²} band, half-metallicity of optimized geometry, and metallicity of x=0.1450 geometry.
Peak differential electron density in the lobes between oxygen ligands for both geometries.

output_contract.notes: All output files are written to /app/outputs. Scoring compares extracted values to hidden reference values with appropriate tolerances.
